About us

Straightforward legal advice from experienced solicitors.

We aim to be easy to reach and easy to understand, whoever you are and whatever your budget.

Our story

Who we are

Confidère Legal gives individuals, families and businesses straightforward legal advice from experienced solicitors. We are based in East London.

The firm is led by Managing Partner Sajid Mahmood, a solicitor with more than fifteen years’ experience in private practice and local government. That combination shapes how we work: we understand the practical demands of preparing a case, and the statutory framework within which public authorities operate.

We advise individuals and families on family, immigration, criminal defence, licensing and housing matters, and give businesses senior support on data protection, privacy and AI governance.

Our values

What you can expect from us

  • i.

    Accessible

    Plain English, clear prices and appointments that fit around you, by phone, video or in person.

  • ii.

    Experienced

    Senior solicitors handle your matter, and you deal directly with the person doing the work.

  • iii.

    Both sides of the table

    We have acted for, and against, public authorities, so we know how cases are built.

What we do
